proposed.explanation: The goal should be incorporated into the program, not bypassed; clarity is the programmer's responsibility. Accepting vague goals leads to programs that don't constrain design effectively; this abdicates programming responsibility. Mixed-use doesn't eliminate flexibility; this dismisses the goal rather than clarifying it. Programming requires testable, specific goals. 'Flexible' is vague.
